title: Boy with Vintage Pedal Car, 1950s Black & White Snapshot Photo
description: A charming black-and-white snapshot from the early 1950s capturing a young boy standing beside his shiny metal pedal car in the driveway of a hillside suburban home. He wears a classic mid-century plaid flannel shirt. In the background, a hillside residence with a terraced yard and utility pole reflects post-World War II American suburban expansion and the golden era of steel toy cars. Note the handwritten name 'Gary' written in blue pen along the top front margin.
